name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  lint-and-test-memory-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: 'uv'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        uv pip install ruff pytest
    - name: Lint memory-mcp
      run: |
        cd memory-mcp
        uv run ruff check .
    - name: Test memory-mcp
      run: |
        cd memory-mcp
        uv run pytest -v

  lint-wifi-cam-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: 'uv'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        uv pip install ruff
    - name: Lint wifi-cam-mcp
      run: |
        cd wifi-cam-mcp
        uv run ruff check .

  validate-readme-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Check README links
      run: |
        # Simple link validation - check if README exists and is readable
        if [ ! -f "README.md" ]; then
          echo "README.md not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "README.md exists and is readable"

name: CI

  lint-and-test-memory-mcp:

      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: 'uv'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        uv pip install ruff pytest
    - name: Lint memory-mcp
      run: |
        cd memory-mcp
        uv run ruff check .
    - name: Test memory-mcp
      run: |
        cd memory-mcp
        uv run pytest -v

  lint-wifi-cam-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: 'uv'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        uv pip install ruff
    - name: Lint wifi-cam-mcp
      run: |
        cd wifi-cam-mcp
        uv run ruff check .

  validate-readme-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Check README links
      run: |
        # Simple link validation - check if README exists and is readable
        if [ ! -f "README.md" ]; then
          echo "README.md not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "README.md exists and is readable"
